test_joint_velocity_control: test the robot joint velocity control by starting velocity control and verifying measured velocities match desired
run_robot_interface_velocity_test: run the RobotInterface joint velocity control test script to validate velocity tracking on a robot
test_test_new_joint_vel_function: test the test_new_joint_vel function to verify measured joint velocities match desired velocities within tolerance
start_joint_velocity_control: start joint velocity control on the robot using RobotInterface.start_joint_velocity_control with a desired velocity tensor
update_desired_joint_velocities: update the desired joint velocities mid-control using RobotInterface.update_desired_joint_velocities with a new velocity tensor
